headlines.title: Making Advanced MicroChips Takes a Global Ecosystem
headlines.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Gideon Lewis-Kraus explains how advanced chipmaking depends on a deeply interconnected global network of specialized companies, including ASML and TSMC, making semiconductor supply chains extraordinarily difficult to replicate or relocate. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Lewis-Kraus describes the remarkable engineering behind ASML's EUV machines and why rebuilding a semiconductor ecosystem in the US is a generational project rather than a simple exercise in reshoring.

headlines.title: ASML (ENXTAM:ASML) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Mixed Analyst Revisions
headlines.summary: Price targets for ASML Holding have shifted, with fair value moving from €2,051.09 to €2,107.73, signalling a slightly higher valuation anchor for the stock. Recent analyst updates show price targets moving both higher and lower, yet many still sit above this fair value estimate and reflect an active debate around how much investors may be willing to pay for ASML Holding over time.

headlines.title: China’s Mid-Tier Emergence Threatens ASML Over the Next 3-5 Years
headlines.summary: A state-owned Chinese firm just started mass producing the exact lithography machines ASML depends on for its China revenue, and the timeline for disruption is shorter than Wall Street expects.

headlines.title: Stock-Split Watch: Is ASML Next?
headlines.summary: ASML has underperformed the broader semiconductor sector, and a stock split could be just what the company needs right now.

description: ASML Holding N.V. provides lithography solutions for the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading, and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. The company offers lithography, metrology, and inspection systems. It also provides extreme ultraviolet lithography systems; and deep ultraviolet lithography systems comprising immersion and dry lithography systems solutions to manufacture various range of semiconductor nodes and technologies. In addition, the company offers metrology and inspection systems, including YieldStar optical metrology systems, a diffraction-based wafer metrology platform to assess the quality of patterns on the wafers; and HMI electron beam solutions to locate and analyze individual chip defects. Further, it provides computational lithography solutions, and lithography systems and control software solutions; and refurbishes and upgrades lithography systems, as well as offers customer support and related services. Additionally, the company offers hardware, software, and services to chipmakers to produce the patterns of integrated circuits. It operates in Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, China, rest of Asia, the Netherlands, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the United States. The company was formerly known as ASM Lithography Holding N.V. and changed its name to ASML Holding N.V. in 2001. ASML Holding N.V. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.
